=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh:669-682 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The retry report function decides on `retry_queued_timeout` with the condition `[ -n "${RETRY_RUN_ID}" ] && [ -z "${RETRY_RUN_STARTED_EPOCH}" ]` plus `retry_seen_queued=1`. If a run has started (so `RETRY_RUN_STARTED_EPOCH` is set) and the loop then times out after a transient error (rate limit, malformed JSON), the function skips `retry_queued_timeout` and falls back to the generic `retry_timeout`.
  WHY: Some timeout scenarios get the wrong status, which can hide the intended `retry_queued_timeout` when the run was actually seen. The source rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high. No other reviewer raised it: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked retry_report_timeout() (lines 487-504) and found no defect.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Phase 4b's budget starts at the adopted run's `run_started_at`." (Stuck states P4: test-and-mark-stable Phase 4b retry budget starts at run_started_at)
  expected_change_site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh, where the retry run's start time sets the editor-budget deadline (RETRY_RUN_STARTED_EPOCH at lines 654-655)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewers cite three things. First, scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh:654-655 sets RETRY_RUN_STARTED_EPOCH=$(date +%s) at poll time, not from the API's run_started_at field. Second, lines 651-666 set the deadline from the local time when polling first sees `in_progress` or `completed`. Third, `run_started_at` is read only afterwards, into RETRY_RUN_STARTED_AT_LOG at lines 662-666, and is used only for logging (lines 686-691 also cited by gemini). Severity disagreement: gemini and openai rated MAJOR, minimax rated NIT. minimax calls the poll-latch defensible, noting it is documented and that the previous editor rejected run_started_at because GitHub sets it equal to created_at for queued runs. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash deliberately did not re-raise this gap. They cite the same reason (documented at scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh:446-448) and the prior editor's won't-fix decision.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
